summary: Logistic Properties of the Americas (LPA) filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, to report that its executive management will participate in The Small Cap Showcase WTR Insights conference on June 9, 2026, in New York City. The filing includes a press release about the CEO's fireside chat and one-on-one investor meetings. No material corporate event, transaction, or change is disclosed. This is a routine investor relations activity, not a special situation.
